title: Oily Creamy Uruguayan Corn Gratin
description: A hearty, earthy, and creamy lacto-vegetarian dish from Uruguay, flavored with lime juice and topped with a crunchy, dehydrated corn crust. This cozy dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the corn kernels, lime juice, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, or until the corn is tender.
In a separate saucepan, heat the heavy cream over low heat until warmed through.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the cooked corn mixture, followed by a layer of the warmed cream, and finally a sprinkle of grated cheese.
Repeat the layering process two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the dehydrated corn flakes over the top layer of cheese.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
